properties.inspection_comments: Purpose: To conduct a food safety inspection in accordance with WAC Chapter 246-215. Due to 35 or more red points, a follow-up inspection will be conducted for the red item violations noted in this inspection report. A fee of $240 will be assessed by mail for all follow-up inspections. If repeated red item violations are observed at a follow-up inspection, an additional follow-up inspection will be required. Notes: -First routine after pre-opening inspection. -Ensure produce is being placed into clean, food safe containers after rinsing at the commissary. Unrinsed produce is not allowed on the mobile unit and produce that is placed back into original packaging requires rinsing again. -Label homestyle microwave for employee use only. If observed being used for customer orders, a commercial unit will be required to be installed. - Inspector suggests purchasing back-up digital probe thermometers to encourage frequent temperature taking. Ensure thermometer is being cleaned/sanitized in between uses. -Provided vomit/diarrhea cleanup plan while on site. Maintain plan on site in case of emergency. - Could not verify whether newly added 1-door countertop cooler was commercial/NSF grade while on site. Unit is currently being used to hold non-TCS soda only. Submit unit make and model to food@tpchd.org for review. - Facility has completed 4 of 5 compliance orders from pre-opening inspection. The following compliance order remains open: -During PO inspection, 3 compartment sink on mobile had running hot/cold running water and was not covered based on the approved conditions. Disconnect hot/cold running water to 3 compartment sink and cover basins of sink per the approved plans. -Facility has covered basins at 3-comp sink, but still needs to disconnect the water to the 3-comp sink, so compliance order will remain open.
